tools.name: get_stock_history
tools.description: Daily OHLCV (split-corrected, raw + adj_close) for one stock, last max_rows rows plus window summary and data-quality metadata.

ticker.description: BIST ticker from the 30-stock universe, e.g. THYAO

start.description: First date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 60 trading days before end.

end.description: Last date. Default and maximum: as_of.

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is returned. Default: last trading day.

max_rows.description: Most recent rows to return (summary covers the whole window).

tools.name: get_index_history
tools.description: Daily OHLCV of the BIST 100 benchmark (XU100), last max_rows rows plus window summary.

index.description: Benchmark index. Only XU100 (BIST 100) is available.

start.description: First date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 60 trading days before end.

end.description: Last date. Default and maximum: as_of.

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is returned.

tools.name: calculate_indicators
tools.description: SMA/EMA/RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ATR/KAMA/Supertrend/Ichimoku values and categorical states for one stock at as_of (dividend-adjusted prices).

ticker.description: BIST ticker from the 30-stock universe, e.g. THYAO

as_of.description: Analysis date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: last available trading day. Nothing after it is used.

config.description: Optional indicator parameters; defaults are standard.

tail_rows.description: Also return the last N rows of close/rsi/macd_hist/bb_pct_b/st_dir (0 = snapshot only).

tools.name: detect_reversal_events
tools.description: Timestamped technical reversal events (RSI/Bollinger/Supertrend/KAMA/MACD/Ichimoku) with 1/3/5/10-day forward return strength vs. history, completed horizons only.

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is used.

direction.description: Which kind of reversal events to detect.

event_types.description: Subset of event types; default all for the direction except bollinger_lower_touch/bollinger_upper_touch, which are used only when named. Valid: rsi_oversold_exit, bollinger_lower_reclaim, supertrend_flip_up, kama_cross_up, macd_cross_up, ichimoku_tk_cross_up, ichimoku_cloud_breakout_up, rsi_overbought_exit, bollinger_upper_rejection, supertrend_flip_down, kama_cross_down, macd_cross_down, ichimoku_tk_cross_down, ichimoku_cloud_breakdown, bollinger_lower_touch, bollinger_upper_touch

lookback_days.description: Trading days of history used for the strength statistics (~5 years default).

recent_days.description: Events within this many trading days of as_of are listed as 'recent'.

cooldown_days.description: Same-type events within this many bars of a previous one are dropped.

start.description: Statistics window start; when start or end is given it replaces lookback_days and every event in the window is listed.

end.description: Statistics window end (default and maximum: as_of).

condition_sets.description: Groups of event-day conditions (all must hold) reported as separate subgroups, e.g. [[rsi_trough, high_volume], [supertrend_bearish, below_ichimoku_cloud]].

tools.name: find_support_resistance
tools.description: Support/resistance levels from confirmed pivots: price zone, touch count, strength, distance from last close.

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is used.

lookback_days.description: Trading days of history scanned for pivots.

tolerance_pct.description: Pivots within this percent of each other form one level.

pivot_window.description: Bars on each side that confirm a pivot.

max_levels.description: Supports and resistances returned (nearest to price).

tools.name: rank_sector_relative_strength
tools.description: Peer-group relative strength: each member's horizon return vs. the sector median and XU100, lag score and rank (1 = most lagging).

sector.description: Peer group name (e.g. Financials, Retail_Consumer, Energy_Utilities, Metals_Mining, Chemicals, Auto_Durables, Construction_Materials, Transport, Telecom, Healthcare, Defense_Tech) or a ticker (its group is used).

tickers.description: Explicit peer list (e.g. the stocks named in the question); overrides `sector`.

horizon_days.description: Return horizon in trading days (typically 5, 10 or 20).

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is used.

tools.name: test_catch_up_history
tools.description: History of similar lags: every past day the ticker trailed the peer median by at least the given gap over L days, and whether the gap narrowed or closed within 5/10/20 days (hit rate, false-positive rate, excess vs XU100, split by sector strength). Completed windows only.

ticker.description: BIST ticker whose lag vs. its peers is studied, e.g. MAVI

peers.description: Explicit peer list (default: the ticker's peer group, ticker excluded).

lookback_days.description: L: trading days over which the lag is measured.

horizons.description: Forward horizons (trading days) at which closing is checked.

min_lag_gap.description: Lag threshold as a fraction (0.05 = 5 points behind the peer median); default: the ticker's current L-day lag.

start.description: First event date (default: 5 years before end).

end.description: Last event date (default and maximum: as_of).

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is used.

tools.name: test_weekday_pattern
tools.description: Tests a calendar/multi-day pattern: occurrences, conditional returns vs baseline, p-value with multiple-testing correction, in-sample vs out-of-sample, per-year stability and whether the effect is just market-wide (XU100 reference).

pattern.description: weekday_return: return on `weekday` vs other days. bounce_after_down_day: next-day return after a down `weekday`. bounce_after_n_down_days: next-day return after n consecutive down closes. weekday_sequence: in calendar weeks where every `down_days` day closed down, the cumulative return of `up_days` in the same week.

down_days.description: weekday_sequence: days that must all close down, e.g. [MON, TUE, WED].

up_days.description: weekday_sequence: days whose cumulative return is the outcome, e.g. [THU, FRI].

oos_start.description: Optional out-of-sample start: in-sample = [start, oos_start), out-of-sample = [oos_start, end], each with full statistics (replaces the 70/30 split).

cost_bps_round_trip.description: weekday_sequence: round-trip trading cost in basis points subtracted for the net mean.

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is used.

n_tests_in_family.description: How many similar patterns were tried (Bonferroni correction). 5 = all weekdays.

tools.name: get_fundamental_metrics
tools.description: Point-in-time financial metrics of one stock (growth, profitability, leverage, liquidity, cash conversion; banks/insurer have their own set) with publication timestamps, data-era flag and valuation multiples.

as_of.description: Analysis date: only quarters already public on that date are used.

period.description: Optional specific quarter 'YYYYQn' (e.g. 2024Q2); it must be public at as_of. Default: latest public quarter.

tools.name: calculate_fundamental_change
tools.description: Change of the latest public quarter vs. the previous quarter and vs. the same quarter a year earlier: ratio deltas always; growth rates only in the nominal (pre-TMS 29) era.

as_of.description: Analysis date: only quarters already public on that date are used.

tools.name: analyze_disclosure_reactions
tools.description: For every quarterly report first published on KAP in [start, end]: metric values and change vs. the previous quarter (improving flag), and the 1/5/20-day stock return, abnormal return vs XU100 and vs the sector median after the publication; summary of improving vs deteriorating quarters. Incomplete windows are flagged, never filled. Association only.

start.description: First KAP publication date included (default: 3 years before end). Filter is on the publication date, not the quarter end.

end.description: Last KAP publication date included (default and maximum: as_of).

metrics.description: Ratio metrics to report (default industrial: ebitda_margin_q, net_debt_ebitda; bank: roe_ttm, nii_assets; insurer: roa_ttm).

horizons.description: Reaction horizons in trading days (reaction day = day 1).

peers.description: Peers for the sector-relative reaction (default: the ticker's peer group).

as_of.description: Analysis date; reports not yet public and prices after it are never used.

tools.name: get_macro_context
tools.description: Macro context at as_of (D-1 rule): USD/TRY, EUR/TRY, DXY, VIX, US 10Y, Fed funds and target range, Brent, gold, S&P 500, and TCMB series (CBRT USD/TRY, policy-rate proxy, CPI y/y by publication date) with changes; optional [start, end] range statistics per series.

as_of.description: Analysis date. Values are taken from the last observation STRICTLY BEFORE this date (global closes happen after the BIST close; monthly CPI only after its publication date).

lookback_days.description: Window (calendar-day observations, ~trading days) for the change figures.

series.description: Subset of series (default: all). TCMB: usdtry_tcmb (CBRT USD/TRY), policy_rate (CBRT funding rate), cpi_yoy (CPI y/y %).

start.description: Optional period start: adds per-series start/end value, change, min/max and observation count over [start, end].

end.description: Period end for the range figures (default and maximum: as_of).

tools.name: analyze_macro_sensitivity
tools.description: Historical association between a stock and one macro factor over [start, end]: correlation, beta, mean stock return when the factor rose vs fell (and vs XU100), per-year stability and the same figures for XU100 (stock-specific or market-wide). D-1 aligned; association only, no forecast.

factor.description: Macro factor: usdtry/eurtry/brent/gold/dxy/sp500 as % change; vix, us10y, policy_rate (CBRT), cpi_yoy (CPI y/y) as level change.

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is used.

tools.name: get_news_events
tools.description: Timestamped, legally accessible news/disclosure metadata for a ticker or topic (title, time, source). Returns SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE while no dataset is installed.

ticker.description: BIST ticker (optional if topic is given).

topic.description: Topic keyword (optional if ticker is given).

start.description: First date; default 30 days before as_of.

end.description: Last date; default and maximum: as_of.

as_of.description: Analysis date; only items published before it are returned.

tools.name: get_speech_features
tools.description: Transcript-derived topics, claims and stance of an approved public video/source, with timestamps. Returns SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE while no dataset is installed.

source_id.description: Id of an approved video/audio source whose transcript features were pre-computed.

as_of.description: Analysis date; sources published after it are not returned.

tools.name: generate_strategy_variants
tools.description: The permitted strategy variants A-E (technical only -> full contextual) as machine-readable specs for run_backtest; E is listed but flagged unavailable.

hold_days.description: Holding period applied to all variants.

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description: Event-based backtest of a strategy variant/spec on the universe: signal shift (entry at next open), costs, trade log, per-period/per-year breakdown, portfolio Sharpe/max drawdown/exposure, XU100 and equal-weight benchmarks, flags for few signals and instability.

variant.description: Use a predefined variant (see generate_strategy_variants). Provide either variant or spec.

trigger_events.description: Bullish events that trigger an entry. Valid: rsi_oversold_exit, bollinger_lower_reclaim, supertrend_flip_up, kama_cross_up, macd_cross_up, ichimoku_tk_cross_up, ichimoku_cloud_breakout_up, bollinger_lower_touch

min_lag_score.description: Stock must lag the peer-group median by at least this many peer standard deviations.

require_strong_sector.description: Peer-group median return must beat XU100 and be positive.

max_net_debt_ebitda.description: Maximum net debt / EBITDA (industrial only; null values pass).

require_roe_not_declining.description: ROE must not be lower than in the previous public quarter.

max_vix.description: Block entries when the previous-day VIX is above this.

max_usdtry_20d_change.description: Block entries when USD/TRY rose more than this over 20 days (hard-risk regime).

hold_days.description: Trading days held after the t+1 open entry.

spec.description: Custom strategy spec; provide either variant or spec.

end.description: Last date (exit must happen on or before it). Default and maximum: as_of.

as_of.description: Analysis date; nothing after it is used.

cost_bps_per_side.description: Commission/tax cost per side in basis points.

slippage_bps_per_side.description: Slippage per side in basis points.

tools.name: check_data_quality
tools.description: Data-quality gate for an analysis: stale/missing data, unexplained extreme moves, zero-volume days, late/restated fundamentals, small peer groups, incomplete macro, look-ahead leakage. Returns a verdict PASS|PASS_WITH_WARNINGS|INVESTIGATE|ANALYSIS_UNSAFE|HARD_BLOCK.

analysis_type.description: Decides which checks are mandatory (peer group for sector_catchup, fundamentals for fundamental_reaction).

uses_volume.description: True if the analysis relies on volume (zero-volume days then matter more).

evidence_dates.description: Dates of the evidence actually used; any date after as_of is a leakage flag.

source.description: Name of the data/evidence item, e.g. 'fundamentals THYAO 2024Q2'

date.description: Date this evidence became public / was observed

tools.name: build_evidence_bundle
tools.description: Builds the observed evidence set (all deterministic facts with numbers) and the committed evidence set (stock-specific, sufficiently sampled, stable, gate-approved) from the tool results recorded for an analysis.

analysis_id.description: Id of the running analysis whose recorded tool results are turned into evidence.
